answer: To resist Sybil swarms, nodes anchor identities in a decentralized validator grove using cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Minting concurrent autonomous agents enforces exponential capital exhaustion, sparking a cost spiral (O(k^n)) where stake escalates per identity. A plume of fraudulent clones thus induces superlinear attacker expenditure, rendering large-scale spoofing economically ruinous.
